data.name: MOT17Labels.zip
data.contents: train/test gt (train only), public detections DPM/FRCNN/SDP, seqinfo; no images

detectors.FRCNN: MOT17 public detections (Faster R-CNN), as distributed
detectors.DPM: excluded by rule: scores in [-0.5, 3.1] are not probabilities

tracker.parameters: library defaults (lost_track_buffer=30, track_activation_threshold=0.7, minimum_consecutive_frames=2, minimum_iou_threshold=0.1, high_conf_det_threshold=0.6, frame_rate from seqinfo)
